ciara: nightly-evals-bot flagged an anomaly for q3 quant sweep on model: redwood-open-12b; structured-output test started producing repeated closing tags ("..." loops) and overflowed token limit. uploading artifact: https://artifacts.internal/runs/9823 nightly-evals-bot: structured-output sanity check failed: 37/500 prompts -> looped closing tags, mean tokens per example 1820 (+1400). severity: high samir: repro attempt: able to trigger locally with int3_group4 quant and cache enabled. short repro below. samir: ``` curl -X POST https://api.redwood.local/v1/generate \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \ -d '{"model":"redwood-open-12b-q3g4","input":"Generate a JSON config for a web component: \\n name: 'banner' \\n" ,"max_tokens":1024}' ``` samir: output snippet: samir: ``` {"component":"banner","html":"
...<\/div><\/div><\/div><\/div>"} ``` jonas: that's odd — the extra closing tags look like parts of previous completions getting appended. could be kv-cache pointer arithmetic under quantized kernels. did you try with prefix cache disabled? samir: disabled cache -> no loop. cache enabled + same batch -> reproducible 80%. mina: engine logs show a cache merge at token idx 1024 with mem offset mismatch: mina: ``` WARN runtime.cache: merge mismatch expected_len=256 got=0 ptr=0x7f9a2b ERROR runtime.kernel: cache_read beyond bounds at seq=1024 ``` eng-runtime-bot: auto-triage attached: suspected regression since commit 7b3d9c (kernel reorder for conv-attn). linking PR: https://git.internal/pr/6219 ciara: hypothesis: the kernel reorder reduced atomicity in cache writes causing stale suffixes to be read for following requests when batched. suggests strong candidate for quant-specific pointer bug since unquantized run unaffected. jonas: plan: 1) add unit test to simulate interleaved cache writes across batches, 2) bisect kernel reorder commit on nightly runner for q3g4 artifact, 3) try fallback: force single-request batching for q3 models in Dedicated for next 12h. ciara: assigning -> samir (repro + test), jonas (kernel bisect), mina (runtime patch candidate). please update thread with PR links. samir: starting local bisection now. I'll post smallest repro and exact commit where behaviour flips.
